intent: End-to-end check that the shorts pipeline works on macOS (Apple silicon, no NVIDIA card), using a Bloomberg Tech episode as the test footage. The deliverables are a by-product of the check and are not published anywhere.

inputs.source_origin: youtube g-YDNJcyuck, 1920x1080 29.97fps 44:08, fetched with yt-dlp --js-runtimes bun (see KI-027)
inputs.words_engine: faster-whisper distil-large-v3, int8 on CPU -- no CUDA on this machine. Proper nouns are unreliable: 'Nvidia' often decodes as 'Invidia'/'in videos', 'Rachel Metz' as 'Retro Metz'. Clip anchors deliberately avoid those words. A hotword list was passed on this run and then deleted: it did not fix the brand it was written for, and it was never measured either way, so it was not worth committing as a channel config.

controls.caption_style: config/presets/bloomberg-tech-vertical.json, with bottom_margin_px overridden in the manifest -- see its _bottom_margin_why
controls.encoder: manifest/preset name h264_nvenc, substituted to h264_videotoolbox on this machine by _encode.py
